title: Clear one square
label: SAT DOWN. SAW THE DESK.
lead: Hook 2, because everyone has dodged a messy desk with a sudden urgent chore, and the laundry is the funny detail people repeat.

hooks.label: THREE MUGS. NO ROOM.
hooks.say: Your desk has room for three mugs, two chargers, and none for the actual work.

hooks.label: SAT DOWN. SAW THE DESK.
hooks.say: You sit down to work, see the desk, and suddenly the laundry feels urgent.

hooks.label: WHY CAN'T YOU START?
hooks.say: Why is the hardest part of working just finding a place to start?

beats.say: You sit down to work, see the desk, and suddenly the *laundry* feels urgent.
beats.scene: A desk at night seen from above, buried in mugs, papers, books and tangled cables. The camera pushes in fast as a paper stack slides and topples.

beats.say: The work is right there, buried under yesterday's mugs and *cables*.
beats.scene: Low, close camera gliding along the clutter. A laptop corner peeks out from under papers; a cable snakes over it.

beats.say: So skip the big clean-up. Clear one square, about the size of a *notebook*.
beats.scene: Top-down. Clutter slides outward, leaving one clean rectangle of bare wood. A notebook drops into it.

beats.say: Put the one thing you're working on there, and nothing *else*.
beats.scene: A desk lamp clicks on over the notebook. Everything around it falls into shadow.

beats.say: The mess can wait. It's been waiting for weeks *anyway*.
beats.scene: Wide shot of the desk. Clutter in the dark, one warm pool of light on the clear square, a pen rolls into place.

beats.say: Send this to the friend whose desk you haven't *seen* in months.
beats.scene: Slow pull back from the lit square until the whole messy desk sits small in the dark room, the lamp still glowing.
